items.title: COVID public-health lawsuit participation

items.supporterOrSubjectExplanation: Coverage frames the lawsuit around limits on executive emergency authority and agency directives.

items.title: Costco liquor permit objection

items.title: 2026 GOP runoff dynamics

items.supporterOrSubjectExplanation: Post-runoff statements framed around unity and moving into general election.

items.title: Election-law restriction criticism pattern
